datasets.name: Legacy rice-gate synthetic feature vectors
datasets.source: Generated by training/train_rice_gate.py; no external source
datasets.annotation_type: generated feature vectors; not image labels
datasets.notes: The feature distributions were sampled from hand-authored normal distributions. Perfect held-out feature metrics do not validate real rice images. Existing gate decisions are retained for compatibility; the trainer now refuses synthetic retraining.

datasets.name: GrainDet-Rice
datasets.publisher: Lei Fan et al.; GrainSpace project; Figshare
datasets.annotation_type: single-grain classification; source describes expert annotations
datasets.rgb_or_grayscale: RGB single-kernel images per project description; archive not inspected locally
datasets.image_resolution: High-resolution acquisition; exact distribution not verified locally
datasets.source_group_metadata: Author-provided train/validation/test splits; physical sample grouping and duplicate relationship not verified
datasets.notes: Project documentation reports expert-confirmed labels and class distribution, but its stated total and split totals do not reconcile (24.7K vs 20K and 24.2K). Figshare API advertises 20K images. Download attempt received HTTP 403 after a partial 146,966,036-byte transfer; the partial file is not a dataset and must not be extracted or used. The 'pest_attacked' class is not specifically verified as weevilled; 'impurities' is not an image-level foreign-object taxonomy. Verify archive labels and source groups before training.

datasets.name: GrainSet Rice
datasets.publisher: Lei Fan et al.; Nature Scientific Data / Figshare
datasets.license: Conflicting records: Figshare API says CC BY 4.0; GrainSet project page says CC BY-NC-SA 4.0
classes: Damage and Unsound grain categories; exact mapping requires annotation inspection
datasets.annotation_type: single-kernel images, masks and rice.xml annotations per Figshare description
datasets.rgb_or_grayscale: Image files in archive; exact modes not verified locally
datasets.image_resolution: High-resolution custom optical acquisition per paper page; exact file dimensions not verified locally
datasets.source_group_metadata: Location and sampling metadata described by authors; mapping from individual images to physical sample groups requires archive inspection
datasets.notes: Figshare API says more than 30,000 single-kernel images and masks; custom metadata mentions training/testing and rice.xml. The research page describes expert annotations including damage/unsound categories, morphology, size and weight. The 2.62 GB archive and labels have not been inspected locally. Conflicting license metadata must be resolved with the publisher before use.

datasets.publisher: Moses, Miglani, Kumar Kankar and Pavan; IIT Indore repository / Computers and Electronics in Agriculture
datasets.license: Not specified on repository record; reuse terms require confirmation
classes: additional classes not verified from accessible abstract
datasets.rgb_or_grayscale: High-magnification images; exact image mode not verified
datasets.source_group_metadata: On-field collection reported; group/split metadata unavailable
datasets.notes: IIT Indore's repository record reports 8,048 images and seven damage classes, but says there are no files attached. The complete class taxonomy, image data, split, license and group IDs could not be verified; do not train from the paper abstract alone.

datasets.name: Rice Grain Defects v1
datasets.real_world: Rice-grain photographs are shown; original capture provenance not stated
datasets.rgb_or_grayscale: Image examples are exposed; exact archive modes not verified
datasets.source_group_metadata: No sample/source-group field found on public card; pages label items as processed/augmented versions of originals
datasets.notes: Primary card reports 2,000 images, object detection, CC BY 4.0 and an 80/10/10 split. An inspected sample filename is Broken0959.jpg with one ground-truth box; another is Broken1808.jpg. Public version page exposes numeric class IDs 0-3, not their names. The exact class map, underlying original IDs, sample-group leakage, and complete samples must be checked after export before training.

datasets.name: rice-grain-quality-detection v1
datasets.real_world: Photographic rice images shown; original acquisition provenance not published
datasets.rgb_or_grayscale: Image examples shown; archive modes not verified
datasets.source_group_metadata: Image pages show group 'rice-quality' shared across samples; no per-lot/source group IDs exposed
datasets.notes: Inspected public image pages show ground-truth box counts and the five listed classes. It is a very small candidate for exploratory adaptation only; class distribution is unpublished and a shared group value prevents establishing a leakage-free test split. Do not report validation metrics or production results from the card's random split.

datasets.name: Rice Image Dataset
datasets.publisher: Murat Koklu dataset page; Kaggle mirror
datasets.annotation_type: single-image variety classification; no defect boxes/masks
datasets.rgb_or_grayscale: Image dataset; described as grain images
datasets.image_resolution: Not established by the inspected listing
datasets.notes: Useful candidate for varietal appearance negatives only after visual quality review. Variety labels do not mean each grain is verified clean, translucent, or non-chalky; it cannot supply defect ground truth by itself.
